study.notes: 2011 conference abstract of SCALE Maintenance (NCT00781937, Novo Nordisk): liraglutide 3 mg vs placebo for 56 weeks after a 12 week low calorie diet run in with at least 5 percent weight loss (422 of 511 randomised 1:1, 212 vs 210 randomised numbers used as n); additional mean changes per arm with a between group p value and no dispersion (route arm_means_exact_p in the pipeline, the subtraction done there); hsCRP in nmol/L (unit recorded); FPG -9.4 vs -2.5 mg/dL with p<0.0001 (bound, no row); SBP and pulse changes printed with ambiguous signs in the capture (1.3 vs 4.0 mmHg p<0.0068; 4.1 vs 3.2 bpm p=0.2), not extracted; pct_weight_change -6.1 is the liraglutide arm's additional 56 week change (placebo -0.1), not placebo corrected; cardiovascular risk factors were secondary endpoints of the trial (TRUE); extracted by the session (S), 2026-10-16

rows.notes: additional mean change at 56 weeks, liraglutide -11.3 vs placebo 1.7 nmol/L, p=0.01 between groups; baseline hsCRP after run in not given (run in decrease 8.9 nmol/L)

json.design: randomised double blind placebo controlled, 56 weeks after diet induced weight loss, 422 randomised

rob.justification: double blind randomised phase 3 (D1 low); 56 week treatment with discontinuations and LOCF not described in the abstract (D2, D3 some concerns); laboratory outcomes (D4 low); registered trial with cardiovascular risk factors as secondary endpoints (D5 low)

doubts: companion full paper needed (Wadden 2013 by the trial name) for the hsCRP unit conversion and the SBP sign
hsCRP in nmol/L pools only after unit handling (see item 4 of the plan)
